title: Symol
body: Win an item, Neopoints or a level-up from the Symol Hole inside the hourly window. The window moves every day, so check the guide for today’s.

title: Grave Tombstone
body: While your petpet is away adventuring, check its status on the main Grave Danger page. One chance per status change, and those change every 10 minutes.

title: Turmaculus
body: Get your petpet eaten by Turmaculus. He sleeps most of the day, so open the page and check; if he is asleep, come back later.

title: Count von Roo’s Deadly Dice
body: Von Roo only appears at night. Tie with him, then win at least 2 levels. Careful: if you play again, tie, and then lose, the avatar is taken back off you.

title: Make A Wish
body: Visit the lookup of a Starry pet with a Starry petpet attached, inside that one minute.
